#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: …
Mrs. Fisher: You look as if your puppy just died.
You: That bad?
Mrs. Fisher: Listen, fishing isn’t for everyone. It’s ok to give up.
You: Aren’t you supposed to root for me?!
Mrs. Fisher: Why would I root for a puppy killer?
You: So I murdered the puppy?! What kind of face did I make?!
Mrs. Fisher: Just forget about it. Go home and take a shower.
You: I will…
